head: 8e19aa24e51aeb4a26bf4d9a057ae2012daadc3b
head_note: The ticket names release/0.5.1 at 2bcf469; that commit is not in this clone. Evidence is rebased to the Builder worktree HEAD (Release botmancers 0.5.1 #112 + workflow controls #113).

legend.classification: supported | supported_when_botmancers_launches | unsupported (for the share_current_session convenience; the explicit session_ref path is supported for every client)
legend.share_current: exact = resolves to exactly one session_ref; fail_closed = session_context_required

claude_code.ambient_signal: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID in stdio MCP subprocesses (documented); also present in this Claude Code session's Bash tool subprocess
why_not_adopted: implicit resume (--continue) hands the MCP subprocess an id that is not the conversation that was continued (probe)
the value is fixed at MCP spawn; documented lifecycle caveats around /clear and implicit resume
it reaches stdio subprocesses only; the Botmancers bridge is Streamable HTTP
translating it would send a raw provider session id across the MCP/service boundary

binding.delivery: per-turn --mcp-config file (0600, provider state dir) with an http entry to Botmancers' /api/v0/mcp whose header Botmancers-Session-Context is '${BOTMANCERS_SESSION_CONTEXT}'; the turn's process env holds the token, never argv
binding.bound_to: (agent_id, session_ref, provider turn ref); valid while that turn process runs, at most 15 minutes
binding.evidence: probe:not-514-claude-mcp-probe#new_http_header_context (header reached every MCP request); code:lib/claude-session-provider.ts claudeTurnArgs (--strict-mcp-config with --session-id/--resume, no MCP entry today)

implicit_resume.ambient: present but a different id than the continued conversation (env_matches_S=false, result_matches_S=true)

clear_reset.ambient: not observable headlessly; documented caveat: the spawn-time value can outlive /clear
clear_reset.evidence: doc:Claude Code CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID lifecycle caveat; inference: a Botmancers -p turn has no /clear, so only non-Botmancers sessions can hit it

client_restart.ambient: each Botmancers turn is a new claude process with a new MCP spawn
client_restart.evidence: code:lib/claude-session-provider.ts one detached process per turn; the previous turn's context is stale

not_botmancers_launched.ambient: present (UUID-shaped) but never accepted; no minted context exists
not_botmancers_launched.evidence: probe:not-514-identity-probe env (this session); model test: an ambient UUID in the header is reason=unsupported

fork.ambient: present, equals the new forked id (consistent)
fork.evidence: probe:not-514-claude-mcp-probe#fork; Botmancers does not fork today

codex.ambient_signal: none: no CODEX_THREAD_ID / CODEX_SESSION_ID in MCP subprocesses (probe); the thread id appears only in structured output (thread.started, thread/start result)
why_not_adopted: there is no ambient caller identity to adopt

binding.delivery: app-server: ThreadStartParams.config / ThreadResumeParams.config = { mcp_servers: { botmancers: { url: <Botmancers /api/v0/mcp>, http_headers: { Botmancers-Session-Context: <token> } } } } on the call that loads the thread into Botmancers' app-server; exec fallback: -c mcp_servers.botmancers.* per process
binding.bound_to: (agent_id, session_ref, thread load in this app-server process); valid while a Botmancers turn on that session_ref is running; revoked when the thread is unloaded or the app-server exits
binding.evidence: probe:not-514-codex-mcp-probe#app_thread_http_header_context (two threads, one process, each saw only its own header); #resume_new_process (new context seen, old not); #resume_same_process (a second resume of a loaded thread does NOT respawn MCP, so the context must be per thread load, not per turn); #exec (per-run override delivered); schema: codex app-server generate-json-schema v2 ThreadStartParams/ThreadResumeParams.config

implicit_resume.ambient: none; `codex resume --last` / `exec resume --last` pick the most recent thread

clear_reset.ambient: none; a new thread in the TUI is a new thread without a minted context
clear_reset.evidence: inference: only Botmancers-loaded threads carry a context

client_restart.ambient: none; the app-server restart reloads the thread with a newly minted context

cursor.ambient_signal: session_id only in stream-json output (system/init); not documented as MCP caller identity
why_not_adopted: no per-invocation MCP configuration (cursor-agent --help lists --approve-mcps only)
the only seams are files: <workspace>/.cursor/mcp.json (inside the user's repository) or ~/.cursor/mcp.json (shared by every chat), neither per session
isolated probe exits at the login check before loading MCP, so env expansion in mcp.json was not observed offline
cursor.upgrade_trigger: Cursor ships a per-invocation MCP config flag or a documented per-call caller identity, and scripts/not-514-cursor-mcp-probe.js --home shows a per-process context reaching the MCP server

new_session.ambient: chat id in stream-json output only

not_botmancers_launched.ambient: IDE chat tabs are not addressable (non-goal)
